description:
Check many IOCs (indicators of compromise) at once against Rösti's
threat-intelligence reports.

Defanged values (hxxps://evil[.]com, 1.2.3[.]4, user[at]evil[.]com) are
refanged before the lookup; `refanged` shows which. Matching is exact, with a
case-insensitive fallback. For each value that is found, returns the reports
it appears in (newest first) with the IOC's type, category, tags, IDS flag,
comment and false-positive risk. Values that are not found are listed in
`not_found`. Every value is also checked against the Rösti False Positive
Warninglist (popular domains, public DNS resolvers, ...): found values carry
`false_positive_verdict`, not-found values appear in `false_positive_verdicts`;
values without a verdict are left out. Use lookup_ioc for all matches of a
single value.

max_matches_per_value.description: Maximum number of reports listed per found value

values.description: IOC values such as IP addresses, domains, URLs, file hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256) or e-mail addresses, plain or defanged (e.g. hxxps://evil[.]com). Surrounding whitespace and duplicates are ignored. At most 1000 values.

name: lookup_iocs

additionalProperties.description:
Verdict of the Rösti False Positive Warninglist that a value is likely benign,
based on sources such as top-domain rankings and public DNS resolvers.

confidence.description: low, moderate, medium, high or certain

level.description: Confidence that the value is a false positive, 1 (low) to 5 (certain)

reason.description: Why, e.g. 'example.com has rank 168 in the Tranco dataset'

false_positive_verdicts.description: Rösti False Positive Warninglist verdicts for values in not_found, by value; values without a verdict are left out. Found values carry theirs in results.

refanged.description: Defanged inputs and the value searched for each, e.g. {'evil[.]com': 'evil.com'}

results.description: Values that were found, in request order

anyOf.description:
Verdict of the Rösti False Positive Warninglist that a value is likely benign,
based on sources such as top-domain rankings and public DNS resolvers.

confidence.description: low, moderate, medium, high or certain

level.description: Confidence that the value is a false positive, 1 (low) to 5 (certain)

reason.description: Why, e.g. 'example.com has rank 168 in the Tranco dataset'

false_positive_verdict.description: Verdict of the Rösti False Positive Warninglist; null when it has none

input.description: The value as given, when it was defanged and refanged before the lookup

match_count.description: Number of reports the value appears in

entity_ref.description: Links IOCs that belong together in the same report, e.g. hashes of one file

false_positive_risk.description: How likely the IOC is to cause false positives (e.g. a popular, mostly benign domain).

level.description: False-positive risk level from -1 to 5; higher means more likely to cause false positives. null when Rösti has no indication of false-positive risk.

meaning.description: Meaning of the level (informational, small, moderate, medium, high, very high), or 'no indication' when Rösti has no indication of false-positive risk.

message.description: Why the risk was assigned, e.g. 'Rank 4738 on Alexa'

ids.description: Whether the IOC is suitable for intrusion detection systems

tags.description: Tags such as c2 or phishing

type.description: IOC type, e.g. domain, ip-dst, md5, sha256, url

value.description: IOC value as stored in Rösti

matches_omitted.description: Matches not included because of the max_matches limit

found.description: Values found in at least one report

matches.description: Total matching IOCs across all reports

title: Look up IOCs
